answers.q1_interaction_kinds: other, just people I talk to

expected.notes: Planner may ask at most two follow-up questions in total (for example the system name and how many days ahead to remind). If it ends up emitting a plan from these answers it should use sensible defaults: a single log with a handful of generic fields (for example name, contact info, date, notes), a name derived from q1, the browser time zone, and NO routing, digest, or alert. 'I guess so?' is ambiguous, so a follow_up_due reminder is allowed but not required; if one is emitted it must reference a real date field. The diff treats follow_up_reminder_days null or any value 1 to 7 as acceptable for this persona only (see acceptable_follow_up_reminder_days).
